Terri Picken s fo r Idaho Go vern o r June 9, 2026 Fo r Immediate Release Contacts: Elle Casner elle@terriforidaho.com 208-860-9211 Dean Ferguson dean@terriforidaho.com 208-790-4530 Picken s C alls o n Little to Jo in Her Op p o sin g A ttack o n C itizen ’s In itiative BOISE–Idaho Democratic governor candidate Terri Pickens opposes a new ballot measure that seeks to silence Idahoans on marijuana legalization. She challenges her opponent, Gov. Brad Little, to stick up for Idahoans, stand up to anti-freedom politicians, and oppose the measure as well. “It’s absurd that politicians think that they know better than the people who elected them,” Pickens said. “They don’t know better. They never do.” Pickens supports a marijuana legalization initiative that is waiting to have signatures verified. She says it makes perfect sense to let citizens decide the matter without filtering it through politicians who are icy toward personal freedom and personal responsibility. “The far-right that once railed against ‘nanny government’ has become fully hostile to our right to make our own decisions. From banning books, attacking libraries, badgering teachers, LGBTQ+ bullying, sanitizing science, assaulting citizen-backed Medicaid expansion, outlawing women’s reproductive healthcare choices and destroying basic religious freedom, this Legislature is out of control and Brad Little is their rubber stamp.” Last week, Republican legislators put House Joint Resolution 4 on the November ballot to amend the Idaho Constitution so only politicians can make decisions about marijuana. “Brad Little has shown no courage when it comes to standing up to these anti-freedom Republicans. I challenge him to find his spine and join me in sticking up for regular Idahoans.”
